name: Arisawa Shiho
source:
A girl who boasts top-class grades in her year. Her personal motto is that "An exam student's job is perseverance". She has a strict and serious personality, and her tone is a little harsh. However, she is very caring and has a gentle side. She works part-time job at a flower shop.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.tokimemo-type.com/tkmkgstype/character/index.html]official website[/url]]
